item.title: Kano nightmare: Dreaded gangs unleash terror on pedestrians, commuters
item.description: LACK of effective security, poor street lighting, and weak law enforcement have left residents of Kano exposed to violent night-time attacks, with criminals targeting pedestrians and commuters. The ICIR documents how ordinary journeys home have become dangerous, leaving victims injured, traumatised, and fearful of moving at night.
